skill.name: business-contact-social-links-skill
skill.description: Extract official websites and social media profile links for businesses using BrowserAct workflows. The skill accepts a company name or website URL and returns discovered contact channels.
skill.summary: Find official business websites and social media profiles with BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs intended BrowserAct API calls and handles BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an authentication secret. Most Markdown backtick and system reconnaissance matches are false positives, but credential handling is confirmed. The highest concern is guidance that can lead users to share an API key in chat.

remediation.suggestion: Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a secure environment variable or secret manager.

remediation.issue: Credential use with third-party API calls
remediation.suggestion: Document that targets and authenticated requests are sent to api.browseract.com. Avoid logging secrets and recommend least-privilege tokens.

remediation.issue: External command invocation with user-selected input
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to pass arguments as argv values and avoid shell interpolation when invoking the Python script.

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable business website and social profile data for outreach. This skill runs BrowserAct workflows to find official websites and social links from names or URLs.
actual_capabilities: Detects whether the target is a company name or website URL.
Starts the matching BrowserAct workflow template for the selected input type.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion, failure, or timeout.
Returns discovered official websites and social media profile links.
Reports missing API key, invalid authorization, concurrency, and task failure messages.
limitations: Requires a valid BROWSERACT_API_KEY before it can run.
Sends target company names or URLs to the BrowserAct API.
Results depend on public website data and BrowserAct template behavior.
Long-running tasks can take several minutes and may time out.

output_examples.output: A grouped summary of each company, its official website, available social profiles, and any missing channels.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a secure environment variable before running the skill.
Review returned links before adding them to outreach systems or public directories.
Use exact company names or official website URLs to improve match quality.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared transcripts.
Do not use results for unsolicited outreach without checking applicable rules.
Do not assume every returned profile is current without human review.

faq.question: What input does this skill accept?
faq.answer: It accepts a company name or a website URL as the target.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate with BrowserAct.

faq.question: Which social platforms can it find?
faq.answer: It looks for LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and related official profiles.

faq.question: Does it run fully locally?
faq.answer: No. It sends authenticated workflow requests to the BrowserAct API.

faq.question: How long can a lookup take?
faq.answer: The script polls for completion and may run for several minutes before timing out.

faq.question: Can results be used without review?
faq.answer: No. Users should verify returned links before using them in outreach, CRM, or research workflows.
